How the 60/40 plan works

20% on booking, followed by staged construction instalments, 5% on completion and 40% after handover. The brochure indicates quarterly post-handover payments of 3.33%.

Why consider post-handover payments?

Spread the property price beyond the scheduled handover instead of paying the entire balance at completion. This is a developer payment schedule; it does not guarantee rental income or remove purchase fees.

60/40 or 50/50?

The 50/50 plan requires 50% during construction and 50% on completion. The 60/40 plan spreads 40% after handover but requires 60% by completion. Compare both against your cash flow.

Know before you reserve

Completion is scheduled for Q4 2028. Dates marked in the brochure are indicative. Confirm your unit price, fees, payment dates, rounding and contract terms before booking. Twelve quarterly instalments of 3.33% total 39.96%; the sales agreement must specify how the remaining 0.04% is settled.

FAQ

Is this a mortgage?

No. These are developer instalments, subject to the sales agreement. Identity checks and source-of-funds documentation may still be required.

Can rent cover the instalments?

Rental income, occupancy and yields are not guaranteed. Plan your payments independently of potential rental income and allow for operating costs.

Is the Golden Visa included?

No automatic visa entitlement is promised. Eligibility depends on qualifying investment value and current rules; these starting prices are below the usual AED 2 million Golden Visa threshold.
